title: Glycemic Load Lookup
description: Search 60 common foods for glycemic index and glycemic load values.
howto: Type any food name in the search box.
Read the GI, typical serving, and GL, plus the low/medium/high band.
Values are typical; preparation and ripeness change them.

faqs.a: GI times the carbs in a serving, divided by 100. It reflects both how fast a food raises blood sugar and how much carb a serving contains.

faqs.q: What counts as low, medium, high?
faqs.a: GL of 10 or less is low, 11-19 medium, 20+ high. GI: 55 or less low, 56-69 medium, 70+ high.
No. They are typical published values. Ripeness, cooking time, variety, and brand all shift GI.
